reasons: llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVISelLowering.cpp:677-682 (inside `if (Subtarget.hasPULPExtV2())`, loop over v2i16/v4i8) adds only setOperationPromotedToType(ISD::SELECT, VT, MVT::i32) and setOperationAction(ISD::SELECT_CC, VT, Expand), plus a 4-line comment. There is no other change: no fork logic removed, no early return, no stub, no test touched, no .td change. Every line serves B144.

Root cause confirmed: fork commit f1b7aebff8c2 '[LLVM/PULP/SNITCH] Support for PULP and Snitch cores/platforms' (2022-08-25) exists. Its RISCVISelLowering.cpp hunk registers v2i16/v4i8 and sets VSELECT and the other actions, but not SELECT or SELECT_CC. Both therefore default to Legal and reach ISel without a pattern.

Upstream references checked at llvmorg-20.1.8. RISCVISelLowering.cpp:288 is SELECT_CC Expand for XLenVT; :494/:525 are SELECT_CC Expand + SELECT Custom for f16/f32; :8344-8348 lowerSELECT turns every vector SELECT into a splat-VSELECT; AMDGPUISelLowering.cpp:553-554 promotes a vector SELECT (v2f32 -> v2i32). The note explains why the fix does not use the Custom+pseudo pattern that upstream uses for Zfinx floats. The explanation holds: Custom would send v2i16 into the RVV splat-VSELECT path. Promote reuses the unmodified upstream i32 path (RISCVISD::SELECT_CC -> Select_GPR_Using_CC_GPR). There is no closer RISC-V reference, since XCVsimd works on i32.
